# Best noise-cancelling earbuds under $150

**Best overall pick for Android: Soundcore Liberty 4 Pro (~$120 with a code)**
- It lists at $149.99. The retailer page I found says the code AFSC20 took $29.99 off in Soundcore's cart on 2026-10-22, bringing it to about $120. The code isn't valid on items already on sale, and checkout has the final word.
- It has adaptive ANC, LDAC, wireless charging, and 7.5 h of battery with ANC on (30 h with the case).
- Caveats: the Liberty 5 Pro has since replaced it, and LDAC doesn't work with two devices connected at once.
- [Buy at Soundcore's US store](https://dealectric.com/go/soundcore-liberty-4-pro). This is an affiliate link, so the site earns a commission at no cost to you. [Source](https://dealectric.com/soundcore-liberty-4-pro)

**Best for iPhone: AirPods Pro 2 (renewed) or AirPods 5**
- SlashGear says the previous-generation AirPods Pro 2 have excellent ANC and can be found renewed for just under $150 on sale. Apple no longer sells them new. [SlashGear](https://www.slashgear.com/2266118/best-noise-cancelling-earbuds-can-buy-affordable-2026/)
- The newer AirPods 5 cost $129, or $149 with the wireless charging case. They have an open fit with no ear tips, so ANC is likely less isolating than in-ear designs. [iTech Level](https://itechlevel.com/best-wireless-earbuds-under-150-2026/)

**Best budget pick: Sony WF-C710N (~$119–128)**
- What Hi-Fi? names it best budget, with "fulsome, controlled bass." It was listed at $119 at Walmart and $128 at Best Buy and Sweetwater. [What Hi-Fi?](https://www.whathifi.com/best-buys/best-noise-cancelling-earbuds-the-true-wireless-way-to-cut-out-background-noise)

**Other good options**
- **Nothing Ear (3):** iTech Level calls it the strongest noise cancelling under $150. It has LDAC, multipoint, and wireless charging. I didn't see a current price, so check before buying. [iTech Level](https://itechlevel.com/best-wireless-earbuds-under-150-2026/)
- **CMF by Nothing Buds 2A:** Tom's Guide's best budget pick, with "great ANC and solid sound quality" at a low price. [Tom's Guide](https://www.tomsguide.com/audio/earbuds/best-noise-canceling-earbuds)
- **EarFun Air Pro 4:** SoundMavericks' top pick, with adaptive ANC, LDAC and aptX Lossless, and wireless charging. Its 7.5 h of battery with ANC on is on the short side. [SoundMavericks](https://soundmavericks.com/best-noise-cancelling-earbuds-under-150/)

**Over budget:** The Bose QuietComfort Ultra Earbuds (2nd Gen, $299) and Sony WF-1000XM6 (about $274–328) top the major reviews. AirPods Pro 3 are listed at $179. [RTINGS](https://www.rtings.com/headphones/reviews/best/noise-cancelling-earbuds)

I only had a direct purchase link for the Liberty 4 Pro. For the others, the review pages above have retailer buttons, and prices change, so check the current price at checkout.

Which phone do you use? That would help me narrow it to one pick.
